name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: Mono key cap with a 1px frame and a heavier bottom edge.
docs: Raster leaves are StyleX. Compile them with @stylexjs/babel-plugin (Vite: @stylexjs/unplugin, Next: @stylexjs/nextjs-plugin). If you would rather not run a compiler, import @noorddev/raster-react instead: it ships precompiled with one stylesheet.

use: Showing a shortcut next to a command or in help copy.
KbdPair to keep a chord together.
avoid: Buttons; a key cap is not a control.

a11y: Renders a native <kbd>; screen readers read the characters. Spell out modifier symbols in surrounding text when they matter.
